name: Project Management Foundations
description: A comprehensive project management method integrating modern agile, lean, and traditional approaches across value strategy and delivery operations.

citations.name: A Guide to the Project Management Body of Knowledge -- Seventh Edition
citations.description: The PMBOK Guide Seventh Edition establishes principles-based project management with performance domains and a value delivery system.

citations.name: PMBOK Guide -- Eighth Edition
citations.description: The eighth edition introduces five focus areas and forty non-prescriptive processes for adaptive project management.

citations.name: Measure What Matters
citations.description: Introduces the OKR framework for connecting strategic objectives to measurable key results across organizational levels.

citations.name: Managing Successful Projects with PRINCE2
citations.description: Provides a structured project management method built around continued business justification, with emphasis on business case and benefits management.

citations.name: ISO 31000:2018 Risk Management Guidelines
citations.description: International standard providing principles, framework, and process for managing risk across all types of organizations and activities.

citations.name: Individual Competence Baseline Version 4.0
citations.description: Defines project management competence elements across people, practice, and perspective domains with progressive proficiency levels.

citations.name: Lean Thinking
citations.description: Establishes principles for identifying value, mapping value streams, and eliminating waste in organizational processes.

citations.name: Disciplined Agile Delivery
citations.description: Provides a decision framework for choosing right-sized project management approaches based on context, including prioritization techniques.

citations.name: The Scrum Guide
citations.description: Defines the Scrum framework including the Product Owner role as the critical bridge between stakeholder needs and team execution.

citations.name: Agile Retrospectives: Making Good Teams Great
citations.description: Provides structured approaches for team reflection and continuous improvement through facilitated retrospective sessions.

citations.name: Kanban: Successful Evolutionary Change for Your Technology Business
citations.description: Foundational text on Kanban method for knowledge work including WIP limits, flow management, and evolutionary process improvement.

citations.name: The Fearless Organization
citations.description: Research-based framework for building psychological safety in teams to enable innovation, learning, and high performance.

citations.name: User Story Mapping
citations.description: Technique for organizing user stories into a two-dimensional map that connects user experience narrative to delivery planning.

citations.name: Servant Leadership
citations.description: Foundational text on the servant leadership philosophy where leaders serve the needs of their teams first.

citations.name: The Essence of Software Engineering
citations.description: Introduces the Essence kernel and language for describing software engineering methods using alphas, activity spaces, and patterns.

narratives.name: Delivering Projects That Create Measurable Value Through Disciplined Collaboration
narratives.description: Overarching narrative connecting value strategy with delivery operations across the project lifecycle.

narrativeContexts.context: Organizations face complex challenges requiring structured project delivery that balances strategic alignment with execution agility, yet many projects fail to connect business value with team performance.

Project Management Foundations provides an integrated method that bridges value strategy with delivery operations, enabling teams to pursue opportunities through disciplined collaboration while managing risks and realizing measurable benefits.

Teams must navigate the tension between strategic planning and adaptive delivery, establishing working agreements, managing backlogs, and continuously aligning stakeholder expectations with evolving deliverables.
Projects that adopt this integrated approach deliver measurable value through confirmed benefits, satisfied stakeholders, and high-performing teams that capture lessons for organizational learning.
